subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix get an opt-in sibling-mention skip policy, and should that contract be a new boolean option or an exclusive requireMention mode?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding message-suppression semantics and new Matrix config requires maintainer intent before an automated fix PR can pick the permanent contract.

options.title: Add a default-off Matrix boolean gate
options.body: Add a Matrix-owned option such as ignoreOtherMentions or skipIfOtherBotMentioned that matches the Slack/Discord pattern while preserving current behavior unless enabled.

options.title: Extend requireMention with an exclusive mode
options.body: Model the behavior as a new requireMention mode, reducing separate knobs but changing the type and documentation contract for an existing setting.

options.title: Defer to broader participation policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until a richer Matrix participation design covers multi-agent room targeting, freshness, and sibling mentions together.

recommendation.title: Add a default-off Matrix boolean gate
recommendation.body: Add a Matrix-owned option such as ignoreOtherMentions or skipIfOtherBotMentioned that matches the Slack/Discord pattern while preserving current behavior unless enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent Matrix allowBots policy and merged the current mention resolver work, making them the best routing candidate for the config contract choice.
